posts.author: Ebon_Maker5
posts.body:
Ok so I know this game has no Linux support I know of,
HOWEVER,
all I own is a steamdeck which uses Linux as an operating system (KDE plasma 5) so I was unpleasantly surprised when I went to make a new project and.... It's only showing windows file locations to save it, so for example the windows "Documents" folder it wants to save to doesn't save to the Linux "Documents folder spite them looking exactly the same and me only having a Linux.... So here's the question- does anyone have any knowledge of how to save stuff to my desktop? (Go figure the "desktop" file isn't actually my desktop) the only way I've found how to circumvent this issue is I have a SanDisk SD card, which displays the file directory as: SDS12 (D: ) and I save all my game files to that (along with the rest of the RPG maker games I have except MV)
my main issue with this is I can't use effekseer without being a gigantic hassle because I run the windows efseeker with wine because I can't code and I have no idea what kind of lunacy installing the Linux version is... There is no way to read off an sd card on effekseer go figure....
Sorry if the wrong place to post help for this issue, I was just wondering if anyone knows some secret directory that can save to a Linux desktop via Windows directory files
Please ask about anything I said if anyone has questions about what I mean because I know it's very confusing, thanks

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
I can't say anything about Linux, but MZ had added the ability to use MV-compatible animations in addition to effekseer in an update a while ago.
Under Windows you would reach that option by right-clicking on an animation slot/ID in the list on the left side, and then selecting "MV-Compatible data in the context menu.
